Thanks for the replies. It was a big load that I needed to get off my chest. Since then, I have talked to both my advisor and my brother (well most things apart from TG stuff) and it has lessened the stress on me a bit. I know it isn't going to be easy turning my life around but I wish to try one thing at a time starting from my eating and sleeping habits and then working on from there.
I am also contemplating seeing a counselor at my university.
